The throwing guard is `assertCan()` in `src/lib/permissions.ts:150`. It runs `explain()` and throws `PermissionDeniedError` when the decision is a denial.

I searched the repo for every reference to it. There are no re-exports, namespace imports or aliases in `src/`, so a name search catches every call. All 14 calling files are in `src/server/services/`, which matches the design: services are the only layer allowed to call `assertCan`. Four other files in `src/` only mention it in comments and don't call it: `invite-member-form.tsx`, `permission-gate.tsx`, `action-errors.ts`, and `permissions.ts` itself.

Two test files also call it: `tests/contract/permissions.test.ts` and `tests/lib/permissions.ownership.test.ts`. I left them out because they're tests, not source files. `tests/repositories/issue-repository.test.ts` spies on it but never calls it.

ANSWER: src/server/services/label-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts
